title: RHETORIC: 500 BC TO 500 AD
description: Examines foundational period(s) in the history and philosophy of rhetoric. Provides understanding, through selected fragments, passages, and dialogues, of how and why the art of rhetoric developed over the span of approximately one thousand years. Explores what relation the historical and philosophical development of rhetoric has to contemporary concerns and issues.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisite: COMM 320.
A minimum grade of D- is required in COMM 320.
